messages:
taylor: Heads-up — Ridgeview just flagged a throughput + p99 latency regression on Dedicated alpha-3. Seen since ~2026-03-16 21:10 UTC. Support attached traces (s3://redwood-support/ridgeview/2034567/trace.zip).

marta: Confirmed. They saw ~2x p99 for the text-generation path. Symptoms: queue depth spike, GPU util oscillations. Customer on 8xA100 pool.

raj: Oncall here, taking it. Can someone post the perf dashboard link and any recent deploys?

 taylor: dashboard: https://console.redwood/reports/ridgeview/alpha-3?range=1h. Last deploy at 2034565000 - runtime: kernel-selector v2.4.1.

liz: quick ask — can we capture a sampling profile? Run: `rbctl profile --cluster alpha-3 --since 15m --out /tmp/ridge.prof` then upload to s3.

raj: running the profile now, will paste when done.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy kernel-selector v2.4.1 -> alpha-3 completed at 2034565100.

miguel: I'm seeing KV cache miss rate spike in the same window. Possible eviction policy change from the recent kernel-selector tweak.

 taylor: good catch. @miguel can you grep for `kvcache.*evict` in the logs? e.g. `rg "evict" /var/log/runtime/* | head`

miguel: pasted snippet from worker-12 logs: ```evict key=conv-abc size=20480 reason=mem_pressure ts=2034567898```

marta: customer reported intermittent 500s? Any errors showing OOMs? I see occasional `OOM` on worker-12 in the timeline.

raj: worker-12 rebooted at 2034567800. Kernel logs show repeated `nvidia_pci` warnings around the same time.

liz: Suggest triage plan: 1) capture profile (in progress), 2) run synthetic benchmark with customer-like batch distribution, 3) try a small canary rollback or toggle for the kernel-selector prefetch change.

 taylor: starting a synthetic run now: `bench/run.sh --model=gpt-medium --seq=1024 --qps=150 --duration=5m` (will link logs).

perf-bot: Synthetic job started: bench-2034567901. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/bench-2034567901

raj: bench results (first 2m): p50=60ms p95=420ms p99=950ms. Baseline (v2.4.0) in prod was p99~430ms.\
miguel: can someone get the kernel-selector config diff between v2.4.0 and v2.4.1? My suspicion is a scheduling/prefetch change.

liz: quick diff: `git diff --stat kernel-selector v2.4.0..v2.4.1` -> `+12 -3` (notable change: `enable_prefetch=false` now default).

 taylor: disabling prefetch could cause CPU-GPU stalls on long-context workloads. @raj can you flip `--enable-prefetch=true` on a single worker (worker-13) to test?

raj: toggling on worker-13 now, restarting the runtime process.

perf-bot: canary restart complete on worker-13. Healthchecks passing.

raj: after restart, p99 on worker-13 for synthetic dropped from ~980ms -> ~450ms. That suggests the prefetch toggle is a likely contributor. Need to rebalance traffic away from worker-12 which is still noisy.

marta: customer-facing update: Sent initial note saying we're investigating and will follow up in 30m.

 taylor: next steps: migrate ~20% of traffic to updated workers, monitor p99 for 30m; if stable, roll to remainder. Capture a full perf profile and upload to s3. Also prepare a hotfix (revert or config override).

miguel: opened PR #1234 to revert the prefetch default (short-term). @taylor @liz PTAL.\
liz: reviewing PR now, left one comment about adding a unit test.

raj: reassigning oncall handoff to @sophia at 2034567925.\
sophia: taking over monitoring and the customer thread. Will watch the dashboards for the next hour and coordinate rollback if needed. Good work team :thumbsup:
